QuestInfo.name: Capture the Curly Cow
QuestInfo.0: You met Alicia on Snowy Mountain 2, so you could find out what she's up to.
QuestInfo.1:
You need to hunt Insectivore Slimes and capture a Curly Cow. 
Hunt 10 Insectivore Slimes on Snowy Mountain 2.
QuestInfo.2: Alicia sent the Curly Cow off to the Ark! You should return to Hazelle and discuss potential defensive measures.
